title: Earthy Dutch Water Broth
description: A comforting and earthy Dutch dish featuring water and pickles, perfect for a relaxing evening meal.
instructions: Combine the water, filtered water, pickle juice, parsley, garlic, bay leaves, black peppercorns, and salt in a large pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add the apple cider vinegar and dried thyme to the pot and stir to combine.
Continue to simmer for an additional 15 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a large bowl and discard the solids.
Return the broth to the pot and simmer over low heat for an additional 5 minutes, or until heated through.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the broth hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Store any leftover broth in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
Freeze the broth for up to 3 months for longer storage.
